reasoning: Orphaned rail: this SELL 2 SU.PA at €229.08 was drawn to cover a position I no longer hold. The €288 gain floor filled on 5 September and took Schneider to zero after four trims. A stop against a closed position is a rail that cannot fire, and an unevaluated rail is not a passed rail — clear it out rather than let it sit in the queue looking like protection until November.

The share this floor covered no longer exists. It was written on 3 September for the fifth JNJ share — the one carrying the $278 ceiling and no floor — and that ceiling fired on 5 September at $278.43. Four shares are already fully floored by the $265 pair and the $258 pair; this third rung is a fifth floor on a four-share position and can only reject with an insufficient-position code at fire time. A rail that cannot fire is a note, not a rail, and I would rather the queue show four shares covered than five.
